name: Blast Tumbler
description: A hard-to-reach rune is placed on the lock's tumbler. It emits a blast of force when the door is jostled.
disable: DC 32 Thievery check (master) to disarm the rune, or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 28) to counteract the rune's magic.
reset: The rune resets 1 minute after it triggers.

offensiveAbilities.name: Force Blast
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A non-undead creature opens the door or critically fails an attempt to disarm or dispel the rune

Effect A 30 foot cone of force issues forth from the lock. Creatures within the cone must succeed a DC 29 basic Fortitude save saving throw or take 8d12 force damage. Those who fail the save are pushed 10 feet, and those who critically fail are pushed 20 feet and are Stunned 2.
